items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I had this quintet, with a very close friend of mine who went to art school with me, his name was Andy Park, he ended up in television.

ctx.x: Was it in small groups or big bands?

No it was small groups. Small groups. I played, I mean in the late 50s, jazz had a huge revival over there, it was on the charts. I mean there was all kinds of traditionally- oriented music that was hit parade music, so there was quite a lot of work. And well I played mostly around the Glasgow area, and with a lot of different groups. And the styles of the band were pretty traditional, although at one time I went to art school in Glasgow, and while I was in art school I had this quintet, with a very close friend…
